description: This file defines Mongoose schemas and models for tenant (organization) data management, including tenant details, user associations, hierarchy, and security features like per-organization salt generation.

classes.name: TenantUserSchema
classes.description: Schema for user information within a tenant, including user ID, role, and groups.

classes.name: TenantSchema
classes.description: Schema for tenant (organization) details, including hierarchy, credits, users, projects, and security parameters.

methods.name: pre('findOneAndUpdate')
methods.description: Middleware to update 'updated_at' timestamp before executing findOneAndUpdate.

methods.name: pre('validate')
methods.description: Middleware to ensure 'orgSalt' exists and 'orgSaltVersion' is set before validation.

methods.name: pre('save')
methods.description: Middleware to generate 'orgSalt' if missing before saving a tenant document.
